{{< include ../_extensions/live/_knitr.qmd >}}

The buttons and captions that `quarto-live` adds to a document -- "Run Code", "Start Over", "Show Hint", "Next Hint", "Show Solution", and the "Exercise", "R Code" and "Python Code" captions -- follow the document language. Set the language with Quarto's own `lang` key in the YAML header, which also translates Quarto's table of contents, code-copy tooltip and other interface text:

````{.yaml}
---
title: Un exemple
format: live-html
engine: knitr
lang: fr
---
````

This page is rendered with `lang: fr`, so the code block below has French buttons:

```{webr}
#| exercise: ex1
1 + 1
```

::: { .hint exercise="ex1" }
Essayez `2 + 2`.
:::

::: { .solution exercise="ex1" }
```r
2 + 2
```
:::

Regional language tags such as `fr-CA` fall back to the base language. A language with no translation falls back to English.

## Available languages

Translations are bundled with the extension, in `live-runtime/src/locales/`:

| `lang` | Language |
|--------|----------|
| `en`   | English (default) |
| `fr`   | French |

To add a language, copy `en.json` to `<lang>.json` in that directory, translate each value, register the file in `live-runtime/src/i18n.ts`, and open a pull request.

## Overriding strings for one document

To change the wording in a single document, or to write a document in a language that is not yet bundled, set the strings under the `live: translations:` YAML key. They are applied on top of the built-in translation for the document's `lang`:

````{.yaml}
---
title: Um exemplo
format: live-html
engine: knitr
lang: pt
live:
  translations:
    run-code: Executar código
    start-over: Recomeçar
    show-hint: Mostrar dica
    next-hint: Próxima dica
    show-solution: Mostrar solução
    caption-exercise: Exercício
    caption-r: Código R
    caption-python: Código Python
---
````

The keys are those of the translation files. Any key left out keeps its built-in string.

The `caption` cell option still overrides the caption of an individual code block, as before.
